app.name: HealthGuard
app.tagline: Understand your symptoms before you see a doctor

disclaimer.heading: This is not a diagnosis.
disclaimer.body: HealthGuard suggests possible conditions from the symptoms you enter, to help you decide whether to see a doctor. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, and it does not recommend medicines.
disclaimer.emergency: If you think this is an emergency — chest pain, difficulty breathing, severe bleeding, confusion or loss of consciousness — contact emergency services now.

intake.title: Your details
intake.whatWeCollectBody: Your name, mobile number, age, height and weight.
intake.whyBody: So a clinician reviewing your symptom check has context. These details are not used by the symptom checker itself — it works from your symptoms only.
intake.retentionBody: Until you withdraw consent, or three years without contact from you.
intake.withdrawingBody: You can withdraw at any time, and we will delete your record. Withdrawing is as easy as giving consent.
intake.name: Name
intake.consent: I have read the notice above and agree to my details being used for this symptom check.
intake.skip: Skip — check symptoms without giving details
intake.optionalBadge: Optional: you can skip this step
intake.errorContact: Enter a 10-digit Indian mobile number, starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
intake.errorConsent: Tick the box to agree, or skip this step below.
intake.contactHint: We never show your full number to anyone.

symptoms.title: What are you experiencing?
symptoms.subtitle: Pick everything that applies. The more accurate your selection, the more useful the result.
symptoms.days: How many days have you had these symptoms?
symptoms.errorNoneSelected: Select at least one symptom so we have something to check.
symptoms.errorDays: Tell us how many days you have had these symptoms.
symptoms.emptySelection: Nothing selected yet. Tap symptoms below to add them.
symptoms.fromDescription: We ticked these from your description. Check them and add anything that is missing.

result.title: What this might be
result.notDiagnosis: These are possibilities ranked by how well your symptoms match, not a diagnosis. Only a doctor can diagnose you. A match score says how closely what you reported lines up with a known pattern — it is not the chance that you have the condition.
result.remediesNote: General self-care suggestions only. HealthGuard does not recommend or prescribe medicines.
result.abstainedHeading: We are not confident enough to suggest a condition
result.abstainedBody: The symptoms you selected do not closely match any pattern this checker recognises. Rather than guess, we would rather tell you that plainly.
result.abstainedAction: Please describe your symptoms to a doctor. You can also try again and add any symptoms you left out.

clinic.noPatients: No patients registered at this clinic yet.
clinic.queueSubtitle: AI drafts need a clinician's sign-off before they enter a record.
clinic.noClinic: Your account is not attached to a clinic. Ask an administrator to grant you a role.
clinic.signInLead: For clinic staff. Patients never need an account.
clinic.signInPanelTitle: Your front desk, triaged before the patient reaches it.
clinic.sessionNote: Staff sessions end after 15 minutes without activity.

describe.title: Describe the problem
describe.subtitle: Type or speak in your own words. You can use English, Hindi or Marathi.
describe.label: What is wrong?
describe.placeholder: For example: I have had itching and a rash for four days
describe.languagesHint: English, हिंदी or मराठी - whichever is easiest.
describe.checkThese: Check these are right. Untick anything that is wrong - nothing is recorded until you continue.
describe.understoodNothing: We could not match anything you wrote to a symptom we know. That does not mean nothing is wrong - please pick from the list instead.
describe.notUnderstoodHint: Please choose these from the list on the next screen.
describe.durationRead_one: You said {{count}} day. Is that right?
describe.durationRead_other: You said {{count}} days. Is that right?
describe.aiNotice: This reading was done automatically and is not a diagnosis. A doctor checks it before it becomes part of your record.
describe.simulatedNotice: Voice input is not connected yet, so this text was an example rather than your recording.
describe.errorFailed: We could not read that just now. Please try again, or pick from the list.

home.title: Understand your symptoms.
home.lead: Tell us how you feel in English, हिंदी or मराठी. HealthGuard suggests what it might be and how urgently you should see a doctor.
home.startDescribeHint: Type how you feel, in any of three languages
home.previewUrgency: See a doctor in the next 1–2 days
home.previewUrgencyHint: Worth a check-up, not an emergency.
home.howLead: About two minutes. No account needed.
home.step1Body: Describe it in your own words, or tick symptoms from the list.
home.step2Body: Conditions that fit your symptoms, strongest first, with how closely each one matches.
home.step3Body: Clear advice on how soon to see a doctor, and safe self-care while you wait.
home.honestLead: Health tools earn trust by being clear about their limits. Here are ours.
home.honest1Title: It suggests, it does not diagnose.
home.honest1Body: You get a ranked list of possibilities with a match score, never a single verdict.
home.honest2Title: It says when it does not know.
home.honest2Body: If your symptoms do not match anything it recognises, it tells you so and points you to a doctor instead of guessing.
home.honest3Body: Only a registered medical practitioner can prescribe.
home.honest4Body: We tell you what we collect before you enter it, you can skip it entirely, and you can withdraw at any time.
home.clinicTitle: Know why each patient is here before they reach your desk.
home.clinicBody: Patients describe their symptoms in their own language while they wait. Your doctors get an urgency-sorted queue of AI drafts to review and sign off.
home.clinicPoint2: Every AI draft needs a doctor's sign-off

footer.madeIn: Made in India, for Indian clinics.
